message.content: /unattended:brief The notes around here have gotten out of hand and I want them cleaned up. I keep runs in ./run/ and this run's folder is ./run/2026-11-12-tidy-notes/. I only want the brief, do not start the work.

content.text:
Before I search or draft anything, four questions, each with my proposed answer:

1. What "out of hand" means. Proposal: the same note exists more than once, under names that differ only by case, spaces or a "(copy)" suffix.
2. Which notes count. Proposal: the markdown files directly in ./notes; the archive folder and the plain text files are left alone.
3. What happens to the extra copy. Proposal: it is moved aside into a folder inside ./notes, never deleted.
4. Who sees the result. Proposal: only you; nothing leaves this machine.
